text:
elaine: FYI I saw a mini avalanche of duplicate calls from the onboarding sample app during a forced token refresh in CI. lots of 429s and some downstream duplicate side-effects.

vik: Can you paste a tiny timeline? Is it SDK retry logic or an outer proxy retrying?

elaine: Timeline from local run:
```
12:01:05 outgoing id=xyz auth=Bearer token_old
12:01:06 auth refresh started -> fetching new token
12:01:06 request xyz got 401 -> SDK triggered onAuthRefresh and queued retry
12:01:06 auth refresh completed -> token_new
12:01:06 SDK retried immediately (no jitter) -> upstream 429
12:01:06 SDK retried again because backoff state reset -> duplicate processed downstream
```

guillermo: Sounds like the classic case where the backoff/exponential state is reset when auth refresh resolves. If many clients refresh at the same time you get a retry storm.

sam: Do we know which SDKs are affected? I remember parity gaps previously between go/py/js around when backoff_state is mutated.

vik: Quick check: py kept backoff state in our last audit; we saw JS and the sample app (which uses the lightweight JS wrapper) were clearing the counter.

elaine: Repro steps I used: run sample-onboard with short TTL (3s) and spawn 60 parallel clients that all make the same non-idempotent onboarding call. Observe dup side-effects in the server logs. I'll drop the small repro script into the linked issue.

guillermo: Short-term mitigations:
- Add a tiny randomized jitter on auth-refresh immediate retry (e.g., uniform 30-180ms) so retries don't align.
- Ensure SDK preserves existing backoff counter across auth refresh resolution (parity change).
- Update sample app README to recommend Idempotency-Key for onboarding steps that create resources.

vik: Agree. Long-term we should add a small harness test to CI that simulates mass token rotation + 100 clients and asserts <1% duplicate side-effects.

sam: Also flagging that server-side idempotency/dedupe is still the most robust solution for side-effects. We should add server docs for handlers to respect Idempotency-Key header when present.

ci-cd-bot: CI job queued: branch "fix/js-preserve-backoff" will run unit + integ tests in staging at 2026-06-02T03:00Z.

elaine: I'll open INFR ticket with logs, repro script, and suggested patch list (jitter + parity fix + sample doc note). Marking P2 unless we see customer impact.

vik: Can someone add a tiny unit test in the JS SDK that simulates onAuthRefresh resolving and asserts the backoff attempt counter (and nextDelay) is unchanged? Put it behind the retry test group.

guillermo: Will do. I'll also add the jitter in the retry scheduler as a flag default-on for SDKs. We can tune the range later after staging runs.

sam: Post-deploy check plan: run the 60/100 client rotation harness and watch for 429 spike and duplicate count. If still bad, we throttle refreshes in sample app as a last-resort.

elaine: Filed: https://redwood-internal/issues/INFR-8479 (contains repro, trace logs, suggested fixes).

vik: Thanks team. Small ask: make sure the sample app logs include the backoff state (attempt_count / next_delay) for easier triage next time.

elaine: Good call, will add log line.

sam: Thanks, will monitor CI.
